name: workflow-map
description: Live workflow map: one row above the prompt (what is running, what is next, segmented progress) that expands into a card graph of parallel steps, plus a full stage-by-stage view, with your mid-plan interjections clearly marked, owners and timing per step, sub-agent sync and plan history.

autoPlan.title: Keep a plan automatically
autoPlan.description: Tell Claude to start and keep a plan for any task of 3 or more steps, and turn Claude's own to-do list into a plan when it forgets. Off: Claude only gets a one-line note and uses the plan when you ask.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Show a short notification when a sub-agent finishes a step, when a step becomes blocked, or when a step in progress has had no update for staleMinutes.

suggestions.title: Suggest next prompts
suggestions.description: After each answer, suggest up to three next prompts as the band's last row (1, 2, 3 put one in the prompt box; 0 hides them).

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: A step in progress with no update for this many minutes is marked amber ("no update"). 0 turns the check off.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. auto = the script of your most recent prompt (Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean; otherwise English). Spanish, French and German only when chosen here.
